-- // skeet-ui v4.2 BUNDLE | gallery rewritten bulletproof + exposed opener
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local STATE_API = nil
pcall(function() STATE_API = STATE end)
local MenuCfg = {Key = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift}
local FV = {Enabled = false, Value = 90}
local function safecb(cb, ...)
    if not cb then return end
    local ok, err = pcall(cb, ...)
    if not ok then warn("[skeet] " .. tostring(err)) end
end
local function Tween(obj, props, t, style, dir)
    pcall(function()
        TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.18, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
    end)
end
local ACCENT_DEFAULT = Color3.fromRGB(146, 180, 255)
local THEME = {
    Main = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 19),
    Side = Color3.fromRGB(21, 21, 25),
    Group = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30),
    Element = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 36),
    Border = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55),
    BorderDark = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 225),
    DarkText = Color3.fromRGB(135, 135, 145),
}
local function New(class, props)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k,v in pairs(props) do if k ~= "Parent" then pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end end
    o.Parent = props.Parent
    return o
end
local function Corner(p, r) return New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 4), Parent = p}) end
local function Stroke(p, c, t) return New("UIStroke", {Color = c or THEME.Border, Thickness = t or 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = p}) end
local function Pad(p, l,t,r,b) return New("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,l or 8), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,t or 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,r or 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,b or 6), Parent = p}) end
local function Connect(sig, fn)
    if STATE_API and STATE_API.connect then return STATE_API.connect(sig, fn) else return sig:Connect(fn) end
end
pcall(function()
    local pg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local gh = nil if gethui then gh = gethui() end
    if gh then local o = gh:FindFirstChild("SkeetUI") if o then o:Destroy() end end
    local o2 = pg:FindFirstChild("SkeetUI") if o2 then o2:Destroy() end
    local rg = nil pcall(function() rg = game:GetService("CoreGui").RobloxGui end)
    if rg then local o3 = rg:FindFirstChild("SkeetUI") if o3 then o3:Destroy() end end
end)
local Library = {}
Library.Accent = ACCENT_DEFAULT
function Library:Create(title, accent)
    if accent then self.Accent = accent end
    local ACCENT = self.Accent
    local parentGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    pcall(function() local gh = nil if gethui then gh = gethui() end if gh then parentGui = gh end end)
    pcall(function() local old = parentGui:FindFirstChild("SkeetUI") if old then old:Destroy() end end)
    local Gui = New("ScreenGui", {Name = "SkeetUI", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Parent = parentGui})
    pcall(function() if protectgui then protectgui(Gui) end end)
    if STATE_API and STATE_API.onCleanup then STATE_API.onCleanup(function() pcall(function() Gui:Destroy() end) end) end
    local Main = New("Frame", {Name = "Main", Size = UDim2.new(0, 620, 0, 450), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -310, 0.5, -225), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Main, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, Parent = Gui})
    Corner(Main, 6) Stroke(Main, THEME.BorderDark, 1)
    local UIScale = New("UIScale", {Scale = 0.96, Parent = Main})
    Tween(UIScale, {Scale = 1}, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
    New("Frame", {Name = "AccentTop", Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,2), BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = Main})
    local TopBar = New("Frame", {Name = "TopBar", Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true, Parent = Main})
    Pad(TopBar, 12, 0, 12, 0)
    New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,-60,1,0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = title or "primordial | lua", Parent = TopBar})
    local subTxt = "v4.2 galrewrite" pcall(function() subTxt = "v4.2 | " .. LocalPlayer.DisplayName end)
    New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,-60,1,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,14), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText, Text = subTxt, Parent = TopBar})
    local Body = New("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,40), Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = Main})
    local Side = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0,150,1,-12), Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,6), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Side, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = Body})
    Corner(Side, 4) Stroke(Side, THEME.Border, 1)
    New("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0,4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = Side}) Pad(Side, 8, 8, 8, 8)
    local ContentArea = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,-168,1,-12), Position = UDim2.new(0,162,0,6), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = Body})
    do
        local drag, startPos, startInput = false, nil, nil
        Connect(TopBar.InputBegan, function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true startPos = Main.Position startInput = i.Position
                Connect(i.Changed, function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then drag = false end end)
            end
        end)
        Connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
            if drag and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local d = i.Position - startInput
                Main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
    end
    Connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(i,g) if not g and i.KeyCode == MenuCfg.Key then Main.Visible = not Main.Visible end end)
    local Window = {} Window.Gui = Gui Window.Main = Main Window.GuiRoot = parentGui
    local tabs = {} local first = true
    local function animatePage(leftCol, rightCol)
        ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0,162,0,14)
        Tween(ContentArea, {Position = UDim2.new(0,162,0,6)}, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        for _,col in pairs({leftCol, rightCol}) do
            for _,box in pairs(col:GetChildren()) do
                if box:IsA("Frame") then
                    box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
                    Tween(box, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function Window:Tab(name)
        local btn = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,32), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText, Text = "  " .. name, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutoButtonColor = false, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = Side})
        Corner(btn, 4) Stroke(btn, THEME.Border, 1)
        local leftLine = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,-8), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,4), BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT, Visible = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = btn})
        Connect(btn.MouseEnter, function() if not leftLine.Visible then Tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,36)}, 0.12) end end)
        Connect(btn.MouseLeave, function() if not leftLine.Visible then Tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30)}, 0.12) end end)
        local page = New("ScrollingFrame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACCENT, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Parent = ContentArea})
        New("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0,8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = page})
        local leftCol = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = page})
        New("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0,8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = leftCol})
        local rightCol = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = page})
        New("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0,8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = rightCol})
        local function select(noAnim)
            for _,t in pairs(tabs) do
                t.page.Visible = false
                Tween(t.btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30), TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText}, 0.15)
                t.line.Visible = false
                Tween(t.line, {Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,-8)}, 0.15)
            end
            page.Visible = true
            Tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32,32,38), TextColor3 = THEME.Text}, 0.15)
            leftLine.Visible = true
            Tween(leftLine, {Size = UDim2.new(0,2,1,-8)}, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            if not noAnim then animatePage(leftCol, rightCol) end
        end
        Connect(btn.MouseButton1Click, function() select(false) end)
        table.insert(tabs, {btn = btn, page = page, line = leftLine})
        if first then first = false select(true) task.spawn(function() task.wait(0.05) animatePage(leftCol, rightCol) end) end
        local Tab = {}
        function Tab:Groupbox(gname, side)
            local holder = (side == "right") and rightCol or leftCol
            local box = New("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Group, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = holder})
            Corner(box, 4) Stroke(box, THEME.Border, 1)
            New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,22), Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,4), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = gname, Parent = box})
            New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,1), Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,26), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Border, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = box})
            local cont = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,28), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = box})
            New("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0,6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = cont}) Pad(cont, 8, 6, 8, 8)
            local G = {}
            function G:Label(txt)
                local l = New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,16), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText, Text = txt, Parent = cont})
                return {Set = function(_, t) l.Text = t end}
            end
            function G:Toggle(name, def, cb)
                local v = def or false
                local row = New("TextButton", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = cont})
                local boxF = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0,14,0,14), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,3), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Parent = row})
                Corner(boxF, 3) Stroke(boxF, THEME.Border, 1)
                local fill = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,1,-4), Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,2), BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT, Visible = v, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = boxF}) Corner(fill, 2)
                New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0,22,0,0), Size = UDim2.new(1,-22,1,0), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = name, Parent = row})
                Connect(row.MouseButton1Click, function()
                    v = not v
                    if v then fill.Visible = true fill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 Tween(fill, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}, 0.15)
                    else Tween(fill, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, 0.12) task.spawn(function() task.wait(0.12) if not v then fill.Visible = false end end) end
                    safecb(cb, v)
                end)
                if cb and v then safecb(cb, v) end
                return {Set = function(_, nv) v = nv fill.Visible = nv end}
            end
            function G:Slider(name, min, max, def, cb)
                min, max = min or 0, max or 100 local v = def or min
                local f = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,38), Parent = cont})
                New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.7,0,0,16), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = name, Parent = f})
                local valL = New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.3,0,0,16), Position = UDim2.new(0.7,0,0,0), Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText, Text = tostring(v), Parent = f})
                local bar = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,6), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,24), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = f})
                Corner(bar, 3) Stroke(bar, THEME.Border, 1)
                local fillB = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0), BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bar}) Corner(fillB, 3)
                local function upd(nv, instant)
                    v = math.clamp(math.floor(nv), min, max) valL.Text = tostring(v)
                    local target = UDim2.new((v-min)/math.max(1,(max-min)),0,1,0)
                    if instant then fillB.Size = target else Tween(fillB, {Size = target}, 0.08) end
                    safecb(cb, v)
                end
                upd(v, true) local down = false
                Connect(bar.MouseButton1Down, function() down = true end)
                Connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then down = false end end)
                Connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i) if down and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then local p = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, bar.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1) upd(min + (max-min)*p, true) end end)
            end
            function G:Dropdown(name, list, def, cb)
                local cur = def or list[1]
                local f = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,32), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = cont})
                New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,16), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = name, Parent = f})
                local btn2 = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,18), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = "  "..tostring(cur).."  ▼", TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutoButtonColor = false, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = f})
                Corner(btn2, 4) Stroke(btn2, THEME.Border, 1)
                Connect(btn2.MouseEnter, function() Tween(btn2, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36,36,42)}, 0.12) end)
                Connect(btn2.MouseLeave, function() Tween(btn2, {BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element}, 0.12) end)
                local open = false local listF = nil
                Connect(btn2.MouseButton1Click, function()
                    open = not open
                    if listF then pcall(function() listF:Destroy() end) listF = nil end
                    if open then
                        listF = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,44), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24), ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = f})
                        Corner(listF, 4) Stroke(listF, THEME.Border, 1) Pad(listF, 3, 3, 3, 3) New("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0,2), Parent = listF})
                        for _,opt in ipairs(list) do
                            local ob = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = opt, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = listF}) Corner(ob, 3)
                            Connect(ob.MouseButton1Click, function() cur = opt btn2.Text = "  "..tostring(cur).."  ▼" if listF then pcall(function() listF:Destroy() end) listF = nil end open = false safecb(cb, cur) end)
                        end
                        Tween(listF, {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,#list*22+6)}, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                    end
                end)
                if cb and cur then safecb(cb, cur) end
                return {SetList = function(_, nl, nd)
                    if type(nl) ~= "table" or #nl == 0 then return end
                    list = nl
                    cur = nd or nl[1]
                    btn2.Text = "  " .. tostring(cur) .. "  ▼"
                    if listF then pcall(function() listF:Destroy() end) listF = nil end
                    open = false
                end, Get = function() return cur end}
            end
            function G:Colorpicker(name, def, cb)
                local c = def or ACCENT
                local row = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), Parent = cont})
                New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = name, Parent = row})
                local prev = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(0,22,0,14), Position = UDim2.new(1,-22,0,3), BackgroundColor3 = c, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = row})
                Corner(prev, 3) Stroke(prev, THEME.Border, 1)
                local opened = false local pick = nil
                Connect(prev.MouseButton1Click, function()
                    opened = not opened
                    if pick then pcall(function() pick:Destroy() end) pick = nil end
                    if opened then
                        pick = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24), ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = cont})
                        Corner(pick, 4) Stroke(pick, THEME.Border, 1) Pad(pick, 8, 8, 8, 8)
                        Tween(pick, {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,86)}, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                        local r = math.floor(c.R*255) local g = math.floor(c.G*255) local b = math.floor(c.B*255)
                        local function apply() c = Color3.fromRGB(r,g,b) Tween(prev, {BackgroundColor3 = c}, 0.12) safecb(cb, c) end
                        local function mkRGB(txt, val, fn)
                            local rr = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), Parent = pick})
                            New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0,14,1,0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText, Text = txt, Parent = rr})
                            local tb = New("TextBox", {Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,18,0,0), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = tostring(val), Parent = rr})
                            Corner(tb, 3) Stroke(tb, THEME.Border, 1)
                            Connect(tb.FocusLost, function(ep) if ep then local n = math.clamp(tonumber(tb.Text) or 0, 0, 255) tb.Text = tostring(n) fn(n) end end)
                        end
                        mkRGB("R", r, function(n) r=n apply() end) mkRGB("G", g, function(n) g=n apply() end) mkRGB("B", b, function(n) b=n apply() end)
                    end
                end)
                safecb(cb, c)
            end
            function G:Button(name, cb2)
                local b2 = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,26), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = name, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = cont})
                Corner(b2, 4) Stroke(b2, THEME.Border, 1)
                Connect(b2.MouseEnter, function() Tween(b2, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38,38,45)}, 0.12) end)
                Connect(b2.MouseLeave, function() Tween(b2, {BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element}, 0.12) end)
                Connect(b2.MouseButton1Click, function() safecb(cb2) end)
            end
            function G:Textbox(name, holder, cb3)
                New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,16), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = name, Parent = cont})
                local tb = New("TextBox", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, PlaceholderText = holder or "...", PlaceholderColor3 = THEME.DarkText, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = cont})
                Corner(tb, 4) Stroke(tb, THEME.Border, 1) Pad(tb, 6, 0, 0, 0)
                Connect(tb.FocusLost, function(ep) if ep and cb3 then safecb(cb3, tb.Text) end end)
            end
            function G:Keybind(name, def, cb4)
                local key = def or Enum.KeyCode.F
                local row2 = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), Parent = cont})
                New("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1,-60,1,0), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = name, Parent = row2})
                local kb = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(0,54,0,20), Position = UDim2.new(1,-54,0,0), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = THEME.Text, Text = key.Name, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = row2})
                Corner(kb, 4) Stroke(kb, THEME.Border, 1)
                local waiting = false
                Connect(kb.MouseButton1Click, function() waiting = true kb.Text = "..." end)
                Connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(i,g) if waiting and not g then waiting = false key = i.KeyCode kb.Text = key.Name return end if not waiting and not g and i.KeyCode == key and cb4 then safecb(cb4, key) end end)
            end
            return G
        end
        return Tab
    end
    return Window
end
local TP = {Enabled = false, Distance = 12, lastToggle = 0, parts = {}}
local function tpGetHum()
    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end
local function tpAlive()
    return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive") == true
end
local function tpHideOne(d)
    pcall(function()
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
            if d:GetAttribute("TPO") == nil then d:SetAttribute("TPO", d.Transparency) end
            d.Transparency = 1
        elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
            if d:GetAttribute("TPO") == nil then d:SetAttribute("TPO", d.Transparency) end
            d.Transparency = 1
        elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") then
            if d:GetAttribute("TPOE") == nil then d:SetAttribute("TPOE", d.Enabled) end
            d.Enabled = false
        end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local Config = {
    Enabled = true,
    FOVRadius = 300,
    TeamCheck = true,
}

local target = {
    current = nil,
}

local function getClosestTarget()
    if not Camera then return nil end
    
    local closestDist = Config.FOVRadius
    local closestPlayer = nil
    
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            if Config.TeamCheck and player:GetAttribute("Team") == LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") then
                continue
            end
            
            local character = player.Character
            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and head then
                local worldPos = head.Position
                local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToScreenPoint(worldPos)
                
                if onScreen then
                    local screenPos2D = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                    local distFromCenter = (screenPos2D - screenCenter).Magnitude
                    
                    if distFromCenter < closestDist then
                        closestDist = distFromCenter
                        closestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return closestPlayer
end

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.05) do
        if Config.Enabled then
            target.current = getClosestTarget()
        else
            target.current = nil
        end
    end
end)

                        Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                        Normal = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                    }
                end
            end
        end
    end

end)
